title: What’s Next for Iran?
gist: Event-listing page for a Nov. 17, 2026 FP Live with Vali Nasr on Iran; the text contains no interview content, only framing: U.S. midterms showed most Americans want the Iran war to end while Trump still dangles escalation. Related session blurbs note Democrats retook both chambers on cost-of-living concerns (tariffs, Iran-war gas prices), and that the U.S. is buying Russian diesel despite an ineffective 'energy cease-fire' in Ukraine.

themes.theme: Iran war escalation vs. domestic war fatigue

insights.claim: The U.S. midterms signaled that most Americans want to end the war in Iran, yet President Trump continues to dangle the possibility of escalation.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Escalation risk remains a live oil-price tail even as political pressure pushes toward de-escalation.
insights.quote: The U.S. midterms served as a reminder that most Americans want to end the war in Iran.
insights.locator: The U.S. midterms served as a reminder

insights.claim: Democrats retook both the House and Senate in the Nov. 3 midterms, with foreign policy an unusually strong ballot driver because tariffs raised everyday prices and the Iran war sent gas prices soaring.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Democratic control of spending and oversight can constrain tariff and war policy in Trump's final two years.
insights.quote: Tariffs have raised the price of everyday goods, and the war with Iran has sent gas prices soaring.
insights.locator: What the Midterms Mean for U.S. Foreign Policy

insights.claim: Trump's so-called energy cease-fire has not stopped Russia from bombing Ukrainian electricity and oil infrastructure or Ukraine from attacking Russian refineries, even as the United States begins purchasing Russian diesel.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Ongoing refinery strikes keep product markets (diesel) tight; U.S. purchases of Russian diesel signal how acute product shortages are.
insights.quote: even as the United States begins to purchase Russian diesel

insights.claim: Growing connections between Russia, Iran, China, and North Korea complicate Ukraine's strategic options.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: An axis of sanctioned states coordinating raises the durability of sanctions-evasion networks.

insights.claim: Israel's Oct. 27 election, its first national vote since Oct. 7, 2023, was seen as a referendum on Benjamin Netanyahu, and whether he or centrist Gadi Eisenkot forms a government will shape policy on Gaza, the West Bank, and U.S. relations.
insights.speaker: Dana Sherne
insights.so_what: Coalition outcome is a key variable for regional escalation risk and the Iran war trajectory.
